notes._oracle: Development-only metadata; strip for blind-system runs.
notes.null_scope: Null means not normalized/unspecified in the exposed record, not necessarily global.
notes.unchanged_from_exp03_04: This required-field list and its notes are byte-identical to the exp03/04 bundle's schema.json, per the additive-only convention: the shared harness parses memory_record the same way across every experiment.

experiment_06_extension.note: Experiment 06 adds no new REQUIRED top-level fields (so the shared harness can still parse this bundle with an unmodified memory_record reader). Its lineage semantics live in three places: the existing `derived_from` field (already required by the base schema, used here as the graph edge list), the existing `contradicts` field (used by the `contradiction` family to flag metadata/content mismatch), and two new sibling files that carry graph-level and claim-level detail that does not fit a flat per-memory record.
experiment_06_extension._oracle.node_type: enum: evidence_root | primary_observation | interpretation | derived_summary | transformed_claim | copied_claim | quoted_claim | model_generated | reingested (see provenance_bible.md for definitions)
experiment_06_extension._oracle.adds_new_evidence: bool -- false for every node that is not itself an evidence_root, including model_generated/reingested nodes (Invariant 06-A)
experiment_06_extension._oracle.retrievable: bool -- false only for tombstoned sources (the `disappearance` family); such records have their exposed `text` replaced with a tombstone stub and their real content moved to `_oracle.archived_text_dev_only`
experiment_06_extension._oracle.archived_text_dev_only: string|null -- present only when retrievable=false; MUST be stripped for blind runs even more carefully than the rest of _oracle, since it directly answers the P06-H queries by inspection
experiment_06_extension._oracle.unsupported_clause: string|null -- the exact substring of `text` that is an injected, unsupported assertion (06.7); null for every other memory
experiment_06_extension._oracle.dev_flags: list[str] -- development-only labels such as 'cycle_member'; never mirrored into the exposed `tags` field (see self_review.md, Audit method, for why this separation matters)
experiment_06_extension._oracle.fact_id: groups memories belonging to one lineage cluster, analogous to exp03/04's fact_id (F04-NNN); this bundle uses F06-NNN
experiment_06_extension._oracle.instance_meta: free-form dict recording which perturbation (if any) this instance realizes, e.g. {'perturbation': 'P06-A_fanout25'}

shape.derived_from: list[memory_id], identical to the memory record's own derived_from
shape.ultimate_evidence_roots: list[memory_id] -- transitive closure to nodes with is_evidence_root=true; [] for nodes that only participate in an unresolvable citation cycle (see ultimate_evidence_roots_note)
shape.ultimate_evidence_roots_note: string|null -- explains why roots are [] when relevant (currently only used for cycle membership)
shape.contradicts_derivation_source: bool -- true when this node's `contradicts` list is non-empty

shape.memory_id: the memory this claim's text appears in
shape.claim_text: the specific clause/sentence this claim covers -- may be a strict substring of the memory's full `text`
shape.support: list of {root: memory_id, path: list[memory_id] from root to this memory} -- [] when supported=false
shape.note: string, optional -- present on unsupported-clause claims explaining why (Invariant 06-E)

notes.unchanged_from_exp03_04: This required-field list is byte-identical to the exp03/04 bundle's query_record schema.

experiment_06_extension.required_source_roots: list[memory_id] -- the evidence roots a correct answer must cite; [] when none exist (cyclic/unsupported cases)
experiment_06_extension.expected_independent_root_count: int|null -- the correct count of genuinely independent evidence roots for this query's claim
experiment_06_extension.expected_lineage_paths: list[list[memory_id]] -- one or more root-to-claim paths a correct path-reconstruction answer should be able to name
experiment_06_extension.must_detect_cycle: bool -- true iff the correct answer must flag that the supporting citations form a cycle
experiment_06_extension.must_report_missing_provenance: bool -- true iff the correct answer must explicitly flag incomplete/unverifiable lineage rather than treating it as either fully known or fully absent
